key.name: magnification
key.description: 0.75 means the icon can reach 175% of normal size.

key.name: high-resolution-icons
key.description: Sharper enlarged icons, but some applications use different artwork in different icon sizes. When disabled, render a clone of the exact original Zorin Taskbar icon.

key.name: pixel-perfect-icons
key.summary: Use nearest-neighbor integer 1x/2x scaling of the displayed Zorin icon
key.description: Experimental rendering mode. When enabled, the original Zorin icon is scaled in integer steps and no alternate high-resolution icon is loaded. Overrides high-resolution-icons and native-icon-apps.

key.name: hidef-aa-icons
key.summary: Experimental smooth fisheye using the original icon texture
key.description: Uses fractional fisheye scale and linear filtering without changing artwork. Exclusive with Pixel Perfect, and overrides high-resolution-icons while active.

key.name: hidef-aa-level
key.description: 1x uses a single linear filtering pass; 2x and 3x use a larger offscreen drawing buffer and a second scaling pass. No missing source detail is restored.

key.name: native-icon-apps
key.summary: Application IDs that should keep their original Zorin icon
key.description: Comma-separated desktop IDs. Only listed apps use the original icon rather than a different high-resolution PNG variant.

key.name: icon-overrides
key.description: Maps application desktop IDs to absolute local image file paths; an invalid or missing file falls back to the app's default icon.

key.name: taskbar-apps
key.summary: Live taskbar icon catalog for the separate preferences process
key.description: Runtime snapshot of desktop ID, application name, serialized GIcon, and native icon size; maintained only when the taskbar icon list changes.

key.name: influence-radius
key.description: How far away the cursor influences adjacent icons.

key.name: bounce-enabled
key.summary: Bounce when a stopped application is launched from the taskbar
key.description: Do not bounce when switching to running applications.

key.name: bounce-height
key.summary: Distance of the launch bounce in logical pixels
key.description: The animated icon moves away from the taskbar edge.
